name: Tana Furniture
description: Tana Furniture is a block WordPress theme crafted for independent furniture makers, custom interior workshops, and design-led stores. Styled for calm domestic aesthetics and WooCommerce integration, it features a signature low-key three-pane photographic stage, responsive offset story rows, and bespoke room measurement layouts. Built with clean semantic markup and full multilingual support, the theme lets craftspeople present made-to-order furniture with clarity and quiet restraint.

summary.en: Independent furniture shop theme: a black stage opening on three photo panes with a stepped headline, a grey band of white cards and line-icon tiles, and offset story rows.

store.withoutPlugin: The shop works without WooCommerce: the home page, the collection and made-to-order pages and the visit page carry the prices and a booking link, and the store templates are not used.
